english.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something with no writing, printing, or marks.
Use this for a page or other surface with nothing written or shown on it.
Use 空白 when a page or other surface is blank and unmarked.

examples.english: There are still a few blank spaces on this form.
examples.traditional: 呢張表仲有幾格係空白。
